content: एवम् {%ind.%} .²1 Thus, so, in this manner or way; (referring to what precedes as well as to what follows); अस्त्येवम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls> it is so; एवंवादिनि देवर्षौ <ls>Ku. 6. 84</ls>; ब्रूया एवम् <ls>Me. 103</ls> (what follows); एवमस्तु be it so, amen; यद्येवम् so; किमेवम् why so; मैवम्, मा मैवम् oh, not so, (do not do so) एवम् has sometimes an adjectival force; एवं वचनम् such words. .²2 Yes, quite so (implying assent); सीता -अहो जाने तास्मिन्नेव काले वर्ते . राम- एवम् <ls>U. 1</ls>; एवं यदात्थ भगवन् <ls>Ku. 2. 31</ls>. It is also said to have the senses of. .²3 likeness. .²4 sameness of manner; .²5 affirmation or determination; .²6 command; or it is often used merely as an expletive. (In the Vedas एवम् occurs very rarely; its place being usually taken up by एव).
